item.title: AgroTech AI Launches Next-Gen Autonomous Drone Crop Scouting Platform
item.description: AgroTech AI today announced the general availability of its Autonomous Drone Crop Scouting Platform, featuring real-time multispectral imaging and automated pest detection models for commercial wheat and corn growers.

item.title: AgroTech AI Enters Strategic Partnership with John Deere for Cloud Telemetry
item.description: AgroTech AI has signed a multi-year global partnership agreement with agricultural equipment manufacturer John Deere to integrate precision yield analytics directly into tractor telematics consoles.

item.title: General European Weather and Grain Commodity Report
item.description: Global wheat futures experienced moderate volatility following revised harvest forecasts across Western Europe, with export volumes expected to remain flat through the final quarter.
